notes:
AE notes and timeline (shorthand) - product team evaluating embeddings + search pipeline. Key context:
- Company: mid-market PLG SaaS (product analytics SDK). Fast read-heavy search across docs + user events.
- Primary ask: reliable embeddings pipeline, low cost per-embed, and fast semantic search for UI (95th pct latency target <100ms for top-k). Throughput: 200-500 QPS for vector lookups at peak; batch jobs: nightly ingest ~3-10M records (initial), long-term 30M+.
- Preference: start with Hosted API to validate model/quality, then transition to Dedicated for predictable cost and VPC isolation. Interested in automatic batching suggestions and quantization recommendations.
- Integration needs: direct connector to in-house vector DB (self-hosted Milvus) + optional Pinecone for cross-region. Wants writable bulk ingest API or S3-to-vector pipeline.
- Security: SOC2 in progress, strict data residency (US), SSO/SAML required, KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs retained 1 year.
- Cost sensitivity/ops: product team cares about per-embed unit economics and token-level billing visibility. Want guardrails for fallback models when Dedicated under capacity.
Recent activity (bullets):
- 2025-11-04: Lead created (Jordan Lee).
- 2025-11-18: Intro call (AE+SE) — broad use case, high-level pricing ask.
- 2026-01-12: Demo hosted API embeddings + example search UX. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-26_kiteport-demo.
- 2026-02-20: Security sync w/ engineering — sent security FAQ (drive link).
- 2026-02-26: Technical deep-dive with SE (Aisha) — discussed batch ingest patterns, vector DB connectors, streaming vs batch.
- 2026-03-02: Exec: internal procurement timeline; security team requested dedicated deployment diagram and KMS detail (ff_2026-03-02_security-sync).
- 2026-03-08: POC scoping call — agreed scope: 2-week hosted API POC focusing on embeddings quality + nightly batch ingest test to Milvus; collect latency and cost KPIs.
- Notes style: fragments, quoting PM: "need 95th <100ms or it's worthless for our search UX".
Next steps / action items:
- AE (Jordan) to confirm POC SOW and allocate credits for hosted API test.
- SE (Aisha) to provide sample batch script and connector template to Milvus (S3->vector job).
- Security to review Dedicated architecture (expected 2-week review).
- Pricing: show committed reserved capacity numbers vs pure hosted cost; prepare 3-tier pricing scenarios.
POC success criteria: embedding quality equal or better than current baseline (cosine recall @k), 95th pct vector lookup latency <100ms at 200QPS, nightly ingest completes within maintenance window, predictable cost per 1M embeddings.
Quick wins mentioned: use Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization to reduce unit cost.
Other: requested examples of A/B fallback policies and automatic model routing for degraded capacity.
